summary: Iteration 4: Tested new '一鍵啟動遊戲' (Windows custom protocol launcher) feature. Backend: 13/13 pytest tests passed including 3 new tests for custom_protocol field (default, update, partial-update preserve). Frontend: verified full UI flow - Settings launch section with protocol-input/download-reg-button/help-button, help-dialog content (Steam/Epic/Battle.net URI examples, copy-reg-button), .reg file download (filename testlauncher-protocol.reg, correct header, contains protocol name + powershell.exe), protocol validation (rejects '123invalid' with error toast, accepts 'testlauncher' with success toast), Sidebar hover buttons launch-game-{id}/copy-path-{id}, TasksView launch-game-link-{id}/copy-path-link-{id}, and launch button triggers '正在啟動' toast. All existing features remain functional.

critical_code_review_comments: launcher.js: launchGame's try/catch will never reach the catch since iframe.src assignment + appendChild rarely throws for custom protocols in modern browsers; the '啟動失敗' toast may never fire. Consider ignoring or noting this UX gap.
SettingsView.jsx protocol validation regex /^[a-z][a-z0-9]*$/i is applied only on save, but the input is lowercased when sending to API. UI could hint that value will be lowercased.
Sidebar.jsx & TasksView.jsx duplicate handleCopyPath/handleLaunch helpers - candidates for a shared hook.
Backend Settings model has no server-side validation for custom_protocol format; client-side check is bypassable via direct API. Recommend adding Pydantic validator matching ^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]*$.
generateRegFile embeds the protocol name directly without escaping - protocol format validation should be enforced before generating the .reg to avoid registry-injection strings.
